selection.reason: The delayed dot-product reducer passed independent full-u64 arithmetic oracles, matched the integrated source, lowered warmed quotient event time, and improved all three aggregation medians in the prespecified full-proof comparisons.

rejected.reason: Six-product cubic formula passed correctness but was slower than delayed dot-product reduction on the fixed-degree compute-heavy screens.
Combined cubic/quadratic Karatsuba passed correctness; quadratic benefit was modest and cubic was inferior to delayed reduction.
Reordered three-term products passed correctness but retaining per-product reduction was slower than the selected dot-product method.

selection.final_assessment: Kept the V100 cubic dot-product reduction. Warmed median latency fell 0.59% for four inputs, 3.51% for eight inputs, and 1.28% for two concurrent eight-input jobs; six of seven aggregation pairs improved. Native results were mixed: a 1.71% lower pooled median with seven of twelve paired wins. Sampled GPU peaks increased by 460 MiB for a single eight-input job and 920 MiB for the concurrent cohort; all unchanged resource budgets passed. These are limited fixed-fixture V100 measurements, not general production qualification.

arithmetic_bounds.input_domain: All six u64 input words, including noncanonical representatives
arithmetic_bounds.accumulation: Two add.cc.u64/addc.cc.u64 chains retain the carry beyond bit 127 in top; all condition-code chains stay inside one asm block.
arithmetic_bounds.borrow_fold: On subtraction borrow, wrapped low >= 2^64-(3*B-1) > B-1, so subtracting B-1 cannot borrow again.
arithmetic_bounds.carry_fold: On addition carry, wrapped sum <= (B-1)^2-1; adding B-1 remains below 2^64.

representation_review.scope: Source review of lazy field representatives at equality checks and output boundaries
findings: Witness multiplication canonicalizes each destination wire before the raw zero and Boolean checks.
Lookup denominators are canonicalized before the raw zero check in batch inversion; its product tree uses field arithmetic without intermediate raw zero comparisons.
Compiler folding canonicalizes outputs; opening and FRI kernels canonicalize stored results.
The selected helper preserves the existing lazy-u64 field contract; no canonicalization boundary changed.

integration_source_check.gate: Existing NVIDIA vendor 0x10de + V100 device name + compute capability 7.0 source prefix

timer_boundaries.four: Aggregation call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, artifact output and CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.single: Cohort launch to worker exit; includes initialization, start barrier, aggregation, artifact output and shutdown; excludes CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.concurrent: Cohort launch to last of two worker exits; includes both initializations, start barrier, aggregations, artifact output and shutdown; excludes CPU audits.
timer_boundaries.wallet: Native ABI proving call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, buffer setup, artifact output and CPU audit.

limitations: One Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB, fixed aggregation fixtures and bounded resource settings.
Three four-input pairs, two eight-input pairs, two concurrent pairs and twelve native pairs; limited sample counts.
Warmed alternating pairs. First-use profiles and warmups are retained but excluded from the qualification medians.
Both pooled medians and within-pair reductions are reported; short native calls remain sensitive to timing variation.
Kernel event totals and inclusive host spans are not additive; gaps in event coverage do not establish GPU idle time.
No cold-cache, Apple GPU, full-block or production qualification in this run.
